scope: Equatorial Guinea medical discovery — AAUCA Faculty of Medicine and Biology

verifiedFacts.claim: AAUCA's official Faculty of Medicine and Biology page advertises a Grado en Medicina and lists entry via selectivity/equivalent qualifications, transfer from UNGE Medical Sciences, or evaluation of another university study plan.
The same official page locates AAUCA in Ciudad de la Paz, Djibloho, Equatorial Guinea and lists its faculty contact details.
The Spanish Ministry of Education's country guide identifies the Universidad Afro-Americana de África Central as an institution in Equatorial Guinea with a Faculty of Medicine and Biology.

holdReasons: No current fee schedule, duration, curriculum, active intake date, complete admissions checklist or international applicant process was found.
The page's reference to medical specialities does not establish an approved postgraduate route; it must not be represented as one without a separate current programme source.
Teaching language, named clinical partners, programme recognition/accreditation, accommodation, scholarship/loan support and graduate-registration pathway are unverified.
nextAction: Obtain AAUCA's current Medicine plan, fee schedule, admissions call and regulator/clinical-training evidence before a complete content payload is assessed.
